name: Patrolling Peacemaker
oracle_text:
This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Whenever an opponent commits a crime, proliferate. (They commit a crime if they target an opponent, anything an opponent controls, and/or cards in an opponent's graveyard. To proliferate, you choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever an opponent commits a crime, proliferate

needs.what: a trigger event fired once per spell cast or ability put on the stack whose targets include one of the controller's opponents, a permanent or spell an opponent of that controller controls, or a card in an opponent's graveyard (rule 700.13), filterable by who committed the crime (here: cause_controller opponent)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: becomes_target fires per targeted object and only for permanents, so it misses targeting a player or graveyard cards and would fire multiple times for one spell with several targets; spell_cast and ability_activated carry no information about whether the targets belong to an opponent; the engine has no crime concept at all
